edit.description: Two joined edits to `the_embedded_lock_clauses_match_todays_hand_written_floors_per_kind` and its `floor_quads` helper (:2415). (1) `floor_quads` reduces a `when` clause's `field` column to `None` — it falls through to `Predicate::target`, which answers `None` for `When` by design (`src/contract.rs:916`: "Guard and body carry no field or schema key of their own"), while a lock row's `field` column for a `when` row carries the **guard's** field (`src/builtin_lock.toml:399`, `:508`; the guard is rebuilt off exactly that column at `src/contract.rs:744`). Give it a `Predicate::When { guard, .. } => (guard.target().map(str::to_string), None)` arm beside the `MentionReachable` one it already carries — the same read `src/engine.rs:1572` takes off the variant. (2) The assertion hand-picks six kinds (skill, rule, memory, command, agent, hook) and none of them carries a `when` clause, which is why the gap survived: replace the hand-written arms with a sweep over every kind `builtin_lock::declarations().kinds` declares, so a floor that grows a predicate the helper cannot project is caught by the kind that grows it. Per-kind prose that survives the sweep must not state a kind's clause inventory — the hook arm's comment at :2783 ("a single `enum` clause over the lifecycle event") is exactly the claim HOOK-CONTRACT-CLAUSES-THE-HANDLER-SCHEMA falsifies; teaching worth keeping (the memory arm's note on the memberless emit binding `memoryAnthropicDefaultContract`) moves to the test's own doc comment.

summary: The floor/lock round-trip pin drops a `when` row's guard field and covers six kinds that carry no `when` — so the guard column is pinned by nobody.

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

tests.asserts: every kind the embedded lock declares round-trips its floor's (predicate, field, gate, severity) quads, behind a vacuity pin that the compared set is non-empty and includes at least one `when` row whose field column is `Some` — red on the pre-fix tree at mcp-server (2 rows) and marketplace (5)

acceptance: `cargo test --test lock_declaration_rows` green over every declared kind, the same assertion red with the `When` arm removed, and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
notes: Measured at d8aed9be over all 15 declared kinds: mcp-server and marketplace mismatch today (`Some("type")` / `Some("plugins[*].source.source")` vs `None`), every kind matches with the `When` arm — no second mismatch class hides behind the widening.
